value.title: Testing EICO 150 repairs and not understanding the problem.
value.description:
I've replaced all of the transistors in the EICO 150 signal tracer in an attempt to reduce the noise levels present. Turns out that someone whom shall not be named didn't pay attention to the transistor pinouts.

In this video, I miss what I did. It took a while of studying the schematic to understand what the problem was, and how to fix it. 

If you want to see the actual testing I planned to do, that will be posted next week. I'm not going to delete this one, however, as I don't want to hide the mistakes I make. That's sometimes part of not understanding your device, and not paying attention to it.

I make mistakes with this stuff, but I have fun with it.

I use a Trekster Radio for this test, find those here: https://www.ebay.com/usr/trekster4tw7


Fixing the speaker: https://wereboar.com/projects/index.php/2026/05/08/the-eico-150-solid-state-signal-tracer-wrapup-and-final-thoughts/
